upgradeSteps.description: v1 scene to v2 template: absolute poses kept as scene_absolute roles, anchor pinned to the source map (TypeScript importer only)
manualDrive takes become pinned simforge.recording/v1 recordings replayed by a replay target; needs the map pin's OpenDRIVE digest when the document holds a take

sensors leave the scenario: actor sensors, the render-defaults extension and the sensor of detected conditions and perception invariants are removed (judged by the standard view); the ego is named explicitly (metricSubject, else the role that carried sensors, else the first vehicle)

meaning.ego: the first role whose actor.class is car, truck, bus, van or motorcycle; none when there is no such role

absentFieldSemantics.note: The ego a render mounts its rig on and the standard field of view belongs to. The v3 -> v4 upgrader writes it explicitly (metricSubject when a vehicle, else the role that carried sensors, else the first vehicle), so only a document written without one relies on this.

absentFieldSemantics.when: anchor.pin.seedParamsVersion is absent too (they are set together or not at all)

meaning.drawIndex: the caller's draw (-1 outside a batch: parameters at their defaults)

absentFieldSemantics.note: A scenario pinned to a draw (instantiate, catalog batch) carries drawIndex and seedParamsVersion: the cell seed is sha256(seedIdentity | seedParamsVersion | siteId | drawIndex). seedParamsVersion is the seed identity of the parameter block frozen at instantiation, NOT the current block's version: editing a parameter changes only that parameter, every other draw (one RNG stream per parameter id) and the engine seed stay. Never compare it with, or repair it from, the current block.

meaning.seedIdentity: anchor.id when it is a string, else meta.name

absentFieldSemantics.note: A pre-pinning document (no simulation block) seeds its simulation from its template id. The one-time pin writes exactly that value as simulation.seed.
A pre-pinning document simulates at the one fixed step, 20 ms.
Documents written before pinning get City ambient traffic with seed ambient-1. Immutable old revisions still resolve through this; drafts had it written explicitly by the one-time pin.
Pinned (current) documents get no generated traffic unless the author adds a profile.
Ambient traffic runs the map signals at their real timing unless the flag is exactly true.
A revision frozen before pinning keeps its legacy render seed, the first 32 bits of its content digest; pinned documents derive it from sha256("simforge.render-seed/v1|" + simulation.seed).
A relative_to role without a typed rigidOffsetM but with the legacy parallel-path extension follows a route-relative path parallel to its reference actor.
